findings.current_text: English source: Other. Catch-all for a file the Library could not classify. Singular adjective/noun, not an action. Rendered inside the sentence ui.library.preview.unsupported ONLY via the generic fallback; see manifest. Short badge beside the file size on a card, list row and the preview header; a single noun, no placeholders. Translate as the locale's ordinary noun for this file kind. The raw machine value (for example 'pptx') is shown only as a data fallback when a newer backend adds a kind this catalogue does not know.
findings.problem: The note says the kind label is rendered inside ui.library.preview.unsupported via the generic fallback. The actual other branch renders ui.library.preview.unsupported_generic with no kind interpolation. This does not affect the correct Urdu label but misleadingly tells future translators that it enters a sentence.
findings.recommendation: Replace that sentence with: For the catch-all other kind, the preview uses ui.library.preview.unsupported_generic; this badge label is not interpolated into the unsupported sentence.
evidence: src/i18n/catalogues/ur/ui.library.json: ui.library.preview.unsupported = "{kind} فائل کا پیش منظر یہاں ایپ میں دستیاب نہیں۔"
src/i18n/catalogues/ur/ui.library.json: ui.library.preview.unsupported_generic = "اس فائل کا پیش منظر یہاں ایپ میں دستیاب نہیں۔"

per_key_audit.reason: اس فائل کا پیش منظر یہاں ایپ میں دستیاب نہیں۔ is grammatical, neutral, logical-order Urdu. Faithful negative availability sentence, names no kind, no placeholder. Exactly parallels legacy {kind} فائل کا پیش منظر یہاں ایپ میں دستیاب نہیں۔ with اس replacing the kind slot; Urdu full stop follows style guide lines 89-94.

آڈیو is natural singular/invariant media noun. Library category.sounds = آوازیں translates English Sounds, not Audio. Justified different term: existing ui.chat.composer.processing_audio = آڈیو پر کارروائی جاری ہے and ui.common.errors.audio_playback = آڈیو چلانے میں خرابی ہوئی۔ use the same audio stem. Not a new inconsistent loanword.
کوڈ matches ui.library.category.code = کوڈ and ui.canvas.files.code = کوڈ. Mass noun, correct singular badge.

DOCX retained as official format acronym; no pre-existing occurrence found in targeted ur catalogue search outside this new key. No contrary localized rendering. Glossary §1 technology official spelling and context technical-token instruction support retention; do not claim existing precedent where absent.

HTML retained, matching existing ui.chat.canonical.supplement.preview_unavailable = ان لائن پیش منظر دستیاب نہیں۔ اس HTML کے لیے غیر تعاون یافتہ وسائل یا دستاویزی مواد درکار ہے۔ دیکھنے کے لیے فائل کھولیں۔
تصویر is the singular of ui.library.category.images = تصاویر; matches ui.canvas.files.attachmentImage = منسلک تصویر.
Markdown retained, matching ui.settings.model.system_prompt.source = Markdown ماخذ and ui.chat.transcript_copy.menu.copy_markdown = Markdown کے طور پر نقل کریں. Proper format name remains Latin.
دیگر matches ui.library.category.other and ui.canvas.file_rows.other = دیگر. Natural short catch-all; metadata issue M1 does not affect translation.
PDF retained, matching existing ui.teamBridge.fileCard.kind = {kind, select, pdf {PDF} text {ٹیکسٹ فائل} container {ZIP} other {فائل}}. No placeholder in the new badge.

PPTX retained as official format acronym. Targeted search found no older literal PPTX rendering in Urdu values; no contrary localized rendering. Same official-spelling policy as DOCX, not falsely certified as prior catalogue precedent.
اسپریڈ شیٹ is singular of ui.library.category.spreadsheets and ui.canvas.file_rows.spreadsheets = اسپریڈ شیٹس. Correct loanword family and spacing.

ٹیکسٹ matches existing plain-file term in ui.teamBridge.fileCard.kind: text {ٹیکسٹ فائل}. ui.library.preview.pptx_text = متن is prose-content/view-mode Text, not the plain-text file kind; different term justified by role.
ویڈیو matches ui.library.category.video and ui.canvas.file_rows.video = ویڈیو; singular of ui.canvas.files.videos = ویڈیوز. Settled Urdu-script loanword, not inappropriate Latin retention.
حسب ضرورت exactly matches existing ui.agents.pages.scope.custom = حسب ضرورت. Natural compact adjective phrase heading; need not force a noun calque.
فارمیٹ matches existing ui.settings.appearance.editor.picker.format = رنگ کا فارمیٹ and Library preview.pptx_failed_detail uses فارمیٹ.
پروجیکٹ matches glossary §2 project → پروجیکٹ. Singular, no confusion with plural Projects navigation.
ماخذ exactly matches ui.library.filter.source = ماخذ; a different group context does not require a different Urdu synonym.
حالت exactly matches ui.library.filter.status = حالت. Correct lifecycle/status heading.
موضوع matches existing ui.teamBridge.create.topic = موضوع (اختیاری). Natural singular subject-matter heading.

قسم matches existing ui.library.sort.kind = قسم and ui.canvas.files.kind = قسم. English Type/Kind are synonymous here in separate controls; same Urdu term does not misdescribe either concept. Do not invent an unnatural lexical distinction solely to distinguish roles.
